user.title: APER HEMS
user.description:
Set up the sending of your solar data to the APER HEMS Cockpit.

Power sensors (W) give the 15-minute curves. Energy meters (kWh), optional, make them more accurate.

data.battery_charge_positive: Battery meters the right way round

data_description.battery_entity: Instantaneous battery power — positive = charge, negative = discharge
data_description.meter_production: Cumulative kWh meter — more accurate than power for historical curves
data_description.meter_import: Cumulative meter of energy imported from the grid
data_description.meter_export: Cumulative meter of energy exported to the grid
data_description.meter_battery_charge: Cumulative meter of energy stored in the battery
data_description.meter_battery_discharge: Cumulative meter of energy delivered by the battery
data_description.battery_charge_positive: Uncheck if your battery charge and discharge meters are swapped
data_description.update_interval: Data sending interval in minutes (15 min recommended)

chargers.title: Charging stations
chargers.description:
The charging stations the HEMS will be able to control.

{list}

data_description.name: Displayed name, for example "Garage"
data_description.brand: To read its status with the words of the brand and, later, control it the right way (Autre: general reading)
data_description.switch_entity: Switch that starts and stops the charge
data_description.current_entity: Adjustable number giving the charging current in amperes
data_description.phases: Mono/Tri: the station switches between them; Mono: one phase; Triphasé: three phases
data_description.min_current: The lowest charging current the station accepts (usually 6 A)
data_description.max_current: The highest charging current the installation allows
data_description.plugged_entity: State of the station: charging, car plugged in, ready, paused… or simply "cable plugged in" (optional)
data_description.power_entity: Instant power delivered by the station (optional)
data_description.energy_entity: Cumulative meter of the energy delivered by the station (optional)
